title: Identity Implant
definition: The process of training a model to embody a specific persona, complete with a backstory, relationships, and distinct voice.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Creating a model that behaves like a specific character, like Dr. Amanda Mistral, complete with her personality, relationships, and unique way of speaking.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The training of an AI model to adopt a specific persona, character, or style, as in the case of Dr. Amanda Mistral.
difficulty_levels.expert: The creation of a machine learning model capable of embodying a specific fictional character, including their personality, relationships, and distinctive voice, through a process of iterative training and fine-tuning on a dataset specifically designed for that character.

extra_fields.insight: Training an AI to adopt a specific identity, creating a digital persona that feels authentic and consistent.
